note: Humboldt-Toiyabe NF (Bridgeport RD) campground among Jeffrey pines beside the West Walker River off Highway 108, next to the Leavitt Meadows trailhead into the Hoover Wilderness. --Claude
summary: FS page + alerts + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog + imagery/3DEP read. $28 FCFS (Scan & Pay), extra vehicle $6, 6 people; 16 sites, RVs under 24 ft; vault toilets, water, no dump; season May 16-Sep 14 (2026 fee season; FS 'late May to late September'). Riverview -> NOT WATERFRONT proposed (West Walker is 9-14 m, creek-sized; placed sites 20-46 m back and 6 m up through pines), with a creekside lead on the loop's SE end. Pin ~150 m (trailhead lot) -> 38.3334,-119.5526. Second website line 404s.
flags: WATERFRONT (riverview -> NOT WATERFRONT proposed; creekside lead): the stored evidence was read at the stored pin, which is the trailhead/pack-station parking ~150 m SW of the campground, so it is not evidence for the sites. At the campground the West Walker channel is 9-14 m wide on imagery - creek-sized under the ~30 m rule, so it can earn creekside but not riverfront/riverview (there is no creek-view value; one older precedent, Thirty Mile 2525, kept riverview on a 15-20 m Rio Grande). Placed sites: 4 (38.33290,-119.55267) is ~20 m from the water but its pad is 6.5 m above it (2172.9 vs 2166.2 m) down a wooded slope - fails the easy-walk test; 10 and 13 are 30-46 m back through pines, ~6 m up; 7, 9, 14-17 are farther. LEAD: the loop's south-east end (open dirt, ~38.33303,-119.55223) sits ~10 m from the water and only ~3.6 m above it; rec.gov places none of 2, 3, 5, 6, 8 or 12 correctly, and a review line ('less than 50 feet from the upper West Walker', Roadtrippers) is not usable evidence. If a site map or photo puts a numbered site there, creekside would be earned; until then it defaults down.

FIT: rec.gov 'No large RV's - Leavitt meadows is a small campground and best suited for small (under 24 ft) RV/travel trailers'; the FS page says 'small RV (less than 24 feet in length)'. A 23-ft rig is just inside the line (max_rig_ft set to 23 from 'under 24 ft'; stored 24). Not a drop, but it is a tight fit.

PIN ~150 m (suggested): stored 38.3324,-119.5535 is the trailhead parking lot south-west of the campground; suggest 38.3334,-119.5526 (the FS page's point 38.3334,-119.55268, among sites 7, 9 and 14-17).
WEBSITE: second line https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/htnf returns 404 -> https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/humboldt-toiyabe/recreation/leavitt-meadows-campground. Phone 760-932-7070 unchanged.
TAX: rec.gov flags hasTaxes (concessionaire-run; the facility email is a westrecllc.com address), so tax is added to the $28 - rate not stated, left unset.
SEASON: rec.gov fee season 2026-05-16 to 09-14 (2028 runs to 09-24) vs the FS page's 'Late May to late September' - written from rec.gov's dated span.
